qa.verdict: This is one of the strongest decks so far. The system is crystal clear: carnival as container for psychological dynamics. Cards like Invisible Rucksack, Inner Critic, and Rescue Loop generate immediate recognition and story. Safety valves (Snack, Whistle, Cosmic Giggle page 7) are exceptionally well designed. Almost no filler. This will produce intense but safe table experiences.

urgent: None critical – deck is highly coherent
quickWins: Clarify loop vs artifact icon usage
